description.zh: 迈阿密南海滩（South Beach）以洁白的沙滩、装饰艺术风格建筑和充满活力的夜生活著称。碧绿的大西洋海水、多彩的人文氛围和永恒的阳光让其成为全美最受欢迎的度假目的地之一。
description.en: Miami's South Beach is known for white sands, Art Deco architecture and vibrant nightlife. Turquoise Atlantic water, a multicultural scene and year-round sunshine make it one of America's top resort destinations.

location.zh: 佛罗里达州迈阿密滩市

zh: 南海滩（South Beach）是全美最著名的城市海滩之一
奥歇尔区Art Deco建筑群，粉白色调独树一帜
科勒尔盖布尔斯、温伍德涂鸦艺术区
en: South Beach — one of America's most famous urban beaches
Art Deco Historic District in pastel pinks and whites
Wynwood Walls street art district and Coral Gables

admission.zh: 海滩免费，Art Deco博物馆约5美元

tips.zh: 11月至4月是旺季，气候宜人；6—10月高温潮湿，偶有飓风。停车昂贵，推荐使用共享单车。
tips.en: November–April is peak season with ideal weather. June–October is hot, humid and hurricane-prone. Parking is expensive — rent a bike or use rideshare.

description.zh: 大沼泽地是北美最大的亚热带荒野，以其独特的「流动草原」生态系统著称——一层缓缓流动的浅水漫过绵延的锯草草地。1979年列入UNESCO世界遗产名录，同时也是国际重要湿地和生物圈保护区，保护着包括美洲短吻鳄、佛罗里达美洲豹在内的濒危物种。
description.en: Everglades is North America's largest subtropical wilderness, defined by its unique 'river of grass' ecosystem — a slow-moving sheet of water flowing over vast sawgrass prairies. Inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1979, and also a Ramsar Wetland and Biosphere Reserve, it shelters endangered species including the American alligator and Florida panther.

location.zh: 佛罗里达州南端，迈阿密西南约50公里
location.en: Southern tip of Florida, ~50 km southwest of Miami

zh: 「草之河」生态系统，北美最大亚热带湿地
可乘气垫船穿越锯草草地，近距离观察美洲短吻鳄
佛罗里达美洲豹、红树林、珊瑚礁三大独特生境并存
en: 'River of grass' — North America's largest subtropical wetland
Airboat rides through sawgrass prairies with close-up alligator encounters
Three distinct ecosystems: Florida panther habitat, mangroves and coral reefs

tips.zh: 11月至4月（旱季）是最佳游览季节，野生动物集中于水源附近，蚊虫较少；夏季湿热且蚊虫众多，需备好驱蚊剂。
tips.en: November–April (dry season) is the best time — wildlife concentrates near shrinking water holes and mosquitoes are manageable. Summer is brutally hot and buggy; bring strong insect repellent.
